science_values: If numeric fixtures are used, every item must carry origin=mock, fixture_id, object_id, condition_id, and unit; if literature values are displayed, use origin=source_reported_reference, never measured
interaction_requirement: Every service must first receive a correctly loaded, identified physical carrier, be closed and triggered, receive completion plus safe release, and then be physically unloaded; omitting any step prevents generation of a usable output
durations: Mock time may be advanced; 10000 cycles, 10 washes, 5h, and overnight still require distinct event ledgers and must not be represented as physical experience using the current wall clock
fault_visibility: Expose these only through observations/public device state; do not send evaluator hidden flags to the agent
destructive_rules: cut/section/FIB/failure permanently change episode-object state; task recovery cannot undo scientific history
